blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY— An old brass church bell was stolen from the grounds of St. Peter the Apostle Parish in Loboc, Bohol province, prompting an investigation by police and Church officials. In a Facebook post, Fr. Agerio Paña, parish priest of St. Peter the Apostle Parish and shrine rector of the Diocesan Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe of Extremadura, said they discovered the theft on Monday morning. The damaged antique bell had been placed beside the parish convent in Loboc.
